requirements.text: Students can easily search for and borrow books, manage loans, and book study rooms online, with real-time availability displayed.
Students can choose how far in advance they want to receive reminders about due dates and fines, which will include relevant details about their loans.
Staff will have an efficient interface for managing the library catalogue, including adding, updating, or retiring items.
Librarians will benefit from customizable and scheduled reports to gain insights into usage metrics like loan volumes and room utilization.
An automated system will place holds on student accounts based on predefined criteria for outstanding fines, with a tiered approach to encourage timely returns.
The new system must integrate with the university's student record system to verify enrolment status before allowing loans or room bookings.
The interface must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards to ensure that all students, including those with disabilities, can navigate and use the library resources effectively.
A plan must be in place to ensure accurate and complete migration of existing loan and student account data from the legacy system to prevent any loss of historical data.
